page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Running head at top with page number at right. Title block centred (division heading, subtitle, italic statement). Then a centred heading BREVIARIUM followed by a list of numbered items in italic. Bottom line has a catchword-like tail "Tom.II." at left, "pp" centred, and "IX. in" at right, which is the start of the next item and is kept as printed. No margin notes.

main_text.head: DISSERTATIO DECIMA QUARTA
main_text.p: QUA Hierarchiam, seu Clerum Ecclesiæ Romanæ dominantem esse Babylonem Magnam probatur Nonò, quia luxuriâ & impuritate carnis se multis modis polluit.
main_text.head: BREVIARIUM.
main_text.l: I. Ad habitum interiorem Babylonis M. pertinet etiam luxuria & impuritas carnis.
II. Ejus Hierarchia rea peragitur demonstratione Syllogismo innexa. Cujus propositionis nexus & Assumptio per singula membra probatur.
III. Hierarchia luxuriæ ansam ejusmodi præbet, ut eam ob carnis infirmitatem & eventum inevitabilem certò post se trahat.
IV. Luxuriæ instrumenta Babylon habet divitias haud vulgares.
V. Hierarchiæ in corradendis divitiis summa solertia exponitur.
VI. Iisdem ad luxum & potentiæ exaltationem abutitur.
VII. Prætextus acquirendarum divitiarum ad externi cultûs splendorem futilitas.
VIII. Uti eam divitiis ad magnificentiam, superbiam, Tom.II. pp IX. in

page.notes: The line "VIII." and the final line are set on one baseline with the catchword "Tom.II." and the signature "pp"; the final line "IX. in" is a fragment that runs on to the next page. The reading "Ejus Hierarchia" and the italic words are read from the scan with some uncertainty.
